legend.civic.adoptNote: Circle size = animals listed for adoption; daily snapshot
legend.civic.pressureNote: Capacity utilization from the latest official monthly report; counties and cities without an official value are transparent.
legend.civic.welfarePointsNote: Source coverage varies; a missing point does not mean the county or city has no such service.
legend.civic.nursingLabel: Nursing facilities · type (circle size = total beds)
legend.civic.nursingNote: Home nursing agencies have no beds, so they are drawn as the smallest dot; this reflects reality, not missing data. Postpartum care centers report beds in the postpartum and nursery columns.
legend.civic.elderlyLabel: Residential elder-care facilities · public/private (circle size = approved beds)
legend.civic.disabilityLabel: Disability welfare facilities · utilization (placed / approved capacity)
legend.civic.disabilityNote: Gray means the source provides no approved capacity, or the capacity is 0 (mostly welfare service centers that do not house residents). It does not mean 0% utilization.
legend.civic.ltcLabel: Registered long-term care facilities · service type
legend.civic.ltcNoteC: (Long-Term Care Services Act). The "long-term care facilities" in the Medical theme are Long-Term Care 2.0
legend.civic.ltcNoteE: ; the two systems cannot be added together
legend.civic.childServiceNote: Early intervention includes hospitals and clinics and overlaps with the Medical theme. Another 29 mobile sites and confidential placement facilities have no address by design and are not on the map.
legend.civic.childcareNote: The list is about 21 months old; home-based childcare (nannies) is not included, as there is no nationwide source for it.
legend.civic.govOfficesNote: Excludes the 162 social welfare service centers (under "Infrastructure › Public facilities › Welfare centers"). The two layers do not overlap; add them together for the total.
legend.civic.orgNoteC: , not service facilities; addresses are mostly offices. Do not use them as a service-accessibility indicator.
legend.civic.approxNote: At z15 and above, the 98 points resolved only to a road segment or district center appear faded with a thicker outline (approximate position, not a street address).
legend.civic.eduLevelNote: Elementary and junior high include attached classes (42 attached elementary, 228 attached junior high); college/university includes 10 Open University continuing-education and 9 religious seminary schools
legend.civic.eduLowZoomNote: Not shown at low zoom (about zoom 7.5 and below). Penghu and Kinmen have 0 records (the source map data link is dead); blank areas do not mean there are no schools.
legend.civic.eduAreaNote: Two readings of the same data as the "Campus Boundaries" layer: that layer colors by school level, this one classes by area.
legend.civic.eduK12Label: Elementary and junior high school districts · polygon precision
legend.civic.eduDistrictJuniorPartial: Junior high district: part of village
legend.civic.eduDistrictNote1: Only 4 cities (Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung, Hsinchu) publish districts; blanks in the other 11 counties and cities mean "no data", not "no school district"
legend.civic.eduDistrictNote2: Overlapping polygons are a feature of the system: 292 shared-district polygons, and one village can belong to 2–3 schools; not de-duplicated
legend.civic.eduDistrictPartial: Light color = only some "neighborhoods" of the village belong to this school ({n} polygons); see the neighborhood list in the popup for the actual assignment
legend.civic.eduDistrictNote4: Taipei is school year {year}; the other three cities are more recent
legend.civic.eduSeniorLabel: Senior high school attendance zones (county/city level · 15 zones)
legend.civic.eduSeniorNote: Colors cycle through 5 hues only to tell neighboring areas apart; they carry no meaning
legend.civic.eduCramLabel: Short-term cram schools · category (14 raw values grouped into 5)
legend.civic.eduCramNote: Cram-school data is updated daily; this is the 2026-08-07 snapshot. Not shown at low zoom (about zoom 7.5 and below), and tiles are thinned below zoom 15 (zoom in to see the full density; few points does not mean few cram schools in the area).
legend.civic.eduInterpolatedNote: Semi-transparent dots = position interpolated along the road segment (84 in total); the rest are exact address matches or official coordinates
legend.civic.eduUniNote1: Circle size reflects enrollment (368 – 34,941 students); a minimum size applies
legend.civic.eduUniNote2: The 21 gray dots have no enrollment figures (continuing-education schools and the Open University are counted under their parent schools; religious seminaries are outside the statistics). This does not mean 0 students.
legend.civic.eduSchoolYear: School locations are for school year {year}
legend.civic.pjIso7: 20+ stations (multiple coverage in the city center)
legend.civic.pjIsoNote: Each polygon counts how many stations cover it at the same time; the city center usually has 20+ overlapping stations.
legend.civic.jpPoliceDegraded: Orange outline = approximate position (22 points); the address was resolved only to the chome / town level.
legend.civic.jpPoliceMapped: Shown on the map: 13,195 points; no coordinates: 1 record (source address missing)
legend.civic.jpMedicalGridNote: zoom < 8: records per 10 km equal-area cell
legend.civic.jpMedicalAreasNote: National Land Numerical Information A38 · 2020 historical edition. These are administrative planning boundaries, not facility service areas; population and area must not be summed by polygon part.
legend.civic.jpMedicalCareNote: MHLW H17. At low zoom, each cell sums the service registrations of the categories currently turned on; this is not capacity, service volume, or the number of unique facilities. At zoom ≥ 8 each dot is one complete service registration; one address can have several.
legend.civic.jpMedicalFacilitiesNote: MHLW Navii. At low zoom, each cell sums the mappable facilities of the categories currently turned on; this is not bed count, capacity, or service area. At zoom ≥ 8 each dot is one complete mappable facility; records without coordinates are listed separately. The midwifery-clinic source covers only 45 prefectures; posted hours do not mean a facility can see patients right now.
legend.civic.osmSnapshot: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · snapshot exploration; not a complete official register.
legend.civic.bicycleNote: OSM snapshot exploration. Where one point has several categories, it is colored in the order repair, air pump, parking, drinking water, toilet. Not a complete official register.
legend.civic.accessibleNote: OSM snapshot exploration. "unknown" does not mean false. Not a complete official register.
legend.civic.coverageNote: OSM mapping density; not service quality, population coverage, or road accessibility.
